test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

A terrible disaster was witnessed by our country.

options.text: Our country had witnessed a terrible disaster.
Our country is witnessing a terrible disaster.
Our country witnessed a terrible disaster.
Our country witnesses a terrible disaster.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Our country witnessed a terrible disaster".**
